title: Phase 8 complementary detection: SOC002-DET-003 identifies the PowerShell Base64 reconstruction behaviour that the SOC002-DET-001 v2 blind spot missed

labeling_convention.OBSERVED: read directly out of a telemetry field
labeling_convention.NOT_VERIFIED: not tested / not auditable in this lab

detection.title: PowerShell Base64 Reconstruction / Decode Behaviour
detection.relationship: complementary and separate from SOC002-DET-001 v2 (not modified or extended)
detection.correlation: SOC002-CORR-002 (DET-003 x Sysmon1 x Security4688 x PowerShell4104 x DET-002 lineage)
detection.trigger: Base64 reconstruction CALL (REC-01..REC-05); the literal word 'Base64' never triggers

alerts.note: operator staging script carrying the payload text as a literal - not the activity under test

controlled_command.decodes_to: plain text only (marker + purpose line); never executed

investigation_summary: DET-003 was built to cover the switch-free Base64 reconstruction behaviour DET-001 v2 misses. It was first replayed against the preserved Phase 7 evidence (the known blind spot), then exercised with a small benign comparison suite, then validated by one controlled live run on SOC002-WS001. DET-003 identified the reconstruction in every view; the live transport remained a DET-001 candidate and a DET-003 non-trigger, showing the two detections are complementary rather than overlapping.
observed_facts: The Phase 7 blind-spot payload (PID 1428) was flagged by DET-003 (REC-01) in all four preserved Phase 7 views (WS001 local + DC1 ForwardedEvents, controlled + session windows).
In every preserved view the payload was DET-001-miss / DET-003-hit and the WinRS transport (PID 2936) was DET-001-hit / DET-003-miss.
One controlled benign execution ran on SOC002-WS001; the marker SOC002-PHASE8-DET003-TEST was printed; exit code 0.
The payload child command line carried -Command + [Convert]::FromBase64String and no encoded-command switch.
Security 4688 (RecId 16123), Sysmon Event 1 (RecId 4600) and PowerShell 4104 (RecId 77450) captured the payload locally; the same RecordIDs reached DC1 ForwardedEvents.
DET-003 flagged the live payload (PID 1268) in all three sources; the live WinRS transport (PID 5468) was a DET-003 non-trigger and a DET-001 candidate.
Correlation linked the DET-003 record with Sysmon Event 1, Security 4688, the 4104 script block and the DET-002 lineage chain to winrshost.exe.
The payload initiated no network connection; the temp body was removed (TMP_REMOVED=True).
The lab's own staging script block (4104 RecId 77434) is a DET-003 candidate labelled CTX-PLUMBING - a documented false-positive source.
A naive 'match Base64' keyword rule fires on benign cases where DET-003 does not (word-only and comment-only mentions).
inferred_facts: DET-003 closes the specific Phase 7 gap because it keys on the decode call, not the encoded-command CLI switch.
DET-001 and DET-003 are disjoint on the observed cases; neither is a superset of the other.
CTX-EXEC-ADJACENT raises triage priority but does not prove that decoded content was executed.
not_verified: Generalisation to other reconstruction styles: custom decoders, fragment-assembled method names, compressed/hex blobs, certutil -decode, multi-stage decoding, non-PowerShell hosts.
Whether DET-003 catches reconstruct-and-execute in practice (execution is inferred from text proximity only).
Behaviour outside this lab, at scale, or where WinRM is not the sanctioned management channel.
Any false-positive RATE (the benign suite is a small synthetic set).
classification_authority: Lab operator (SOC-002 operations-centre lab); controlled, benign, authorised technique-shape validation.

detection_result.det001_v2: MISS on the payload (trigger = encoded-command CLI switch only)
detection_result.det002: CONTEXT - WinRM-rooted lineage recorded, no verdict
detection_result.corr002: CONNECTED - Sysmon1 + Security4688 + PowerShell4104 + DET-002 lineage
detection_result.phase7_back_test: 4 of 4 preserved views identified the exact Phase 7 payload

analyst_conclusion: DET-003 is implemented separately from DET-001 v2 and identifies the Base64 reconstruction behaviour the DET-001 v2 blind spot missed, without alerting on the literal word Base64. The controlled activity was benign and did nothing beyond reconstructing and printing a marker. No compromise, attack or adversary is claimed.
recommended_follow_up: Decide whether CORR-001 should correlate on DET-002 lineage alone now that DET-003 supplies a switch-free signal.
Consider handling operator staging traffic (CTX-PLUMBING) with a separately auditable enrichment rather than raw volume.
Keep DET-001 v2 and DET-003 as two separately auditable coverage claims; do not fold DET-003 into DET-001's trigger.
Do not broaden the BASE-01 baseline to depth-3 powershell-in-powershell.
